# IPluginBuilder

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · interface

```csharp
public interface IPluginBuilder
```

Collects the components of a plugin in [`IPlugin.Configure`](IPlugin.md#configure).

Each component class must have a [`PluginComponentAttribute`](PluginComponentAttribute.md) that names its type, for example `acme.usb.eject`. The type must start with the plugin id from `plugin.yaml`.

## Methods

### AddAction

```csharp
IPluginBuilder AddAction(IPluginAction action)
```

Adds an action. Implement [`IRevertiblePluginAction`](IRevertiblePluginAction.md) to let profiles undo it.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | The action. |

**Returns:** The builder, for chaining.
